reviews.title: Lost My 300+ Day Streak Because Nothing Syncs
reviews.text:
I wasted nearly a year using this app, only to find out that all of my progress was stored locally on my phone instead of being tied to my account. After my phone was damaged, I assumed I could simply log in on another device and continue my 300+ day streak. Unfortunately, that’s not how this app works.

When I finally heard back from customer support, they told me there was nothing they could do because step data is stored separately on each device and isn’t synced to your account. That completely defeats the purpose of creating a login in the first place.

Losing over 300 days of progress because of a damaged phone is incredibly frustrating. If you’re looking for a step tracker, I’d recommend choosing one that actually syncs your data across devices and has customer support that can help when something goes wrong. Save yourself the disappointment and download a better app with a more reliable system

reviews.title: Step count
reviews.text:
Used to love this app, but it seems it is no longer counting my steps accurately. I have had some health issues over the last few years so thought it was that. However I happened to be walking with a friend, we walked exactly the same distance all day, but his steps were double my count easily. Then just to test, we gave done the ssme, and the same happened, his steps way more than mine. 
Set up properly with weight, height etc. 
I have looked back at past years, and there is a distinct change from when I upgraded to an iPhone 12 from an earlier iPhone( changed December 24). Since then my step count has been way under what was before, even though my health issues were resolved in 2024. 
Very unimpressed now. I was using it to see how I was doing, now I don’t believe the data!!

reviews.title: Does not sync with Fitbit
reviews.text:
UPDATE: After contacting the developer, I was told to wait for an update to fix this known issue. I waited and updated and still, the leaderboard is off by thousands from your actual step count. The developer is not taking the necessary steps to fix this bug!!! If I could rate it zero I would!!!

I have followed all the steps to sync my Fitbit to this app. I’ve deleted accounts and started new ones, deleted apps and redownloaded them. Still, my Fitbit will not sync to this app. I’ve contacted the developers with no response. Wanted to love this, but it just does not work correctly. My steps are way off from my friends list which is the whole point I downloaded this in the first place. For accountability and challenge, however my steps consistently show me far behind what I actually have which is demoralizing.
